facts.text: Strike pays more than the route
facts.why: The strike pays nothing. The newsies strike because Pulitzer raised the price per hundred papers from 50 to 60 cents.
facts.fix: 60 cents a hundred, up from fifty, so we strike

facts.text: Medda's shout after the show at Irving Hall.
facts.why: Irving Hall is the real 1899 rally venue. The film summary places the rally at Medda Larkson's theatre, and I could not confirm the film names Irving Hall.
facts.fix: Medda's shout after the show at her theatre.

vibe.verdict: The newspaper layout is the best thing here, and the world fits the film, but the food does not pull from the film's scenes.
